name: factstore-ecom-ops
doc: Supply side of a brand that makes in China and sells online: suppliers, SKUs and their IDs in each system, purchase orders, inspections, shipments, customs entries and stock by location.

attributes.doc: Short code we use for a supplier, e.g. NBBW.
Supplier's legal name as printed on its invoices.
Supplier's registered Chinese name.
Postal address of a supplier's factory.
UN/LOCODE of the port a supplier ships from, e.g. CNNGB.
Currency a supplier invoices in.
Payment terms agreed with a supplier, e.g. 30% deposit, 70% before shipment.
Incoterm a supplier sells on, with the named place, e.g. FOB Ningbo.
Our main contact person at a supplier.
Our SKU code for a sellable product variant, e.g. AH-KTL-0001-BLK.
Product name and variant as we sell it.
Three-letter code of the product family a SKU belongs to, e.g. KTL.
Supplier that makes a SKU.
HTSUS tariff code a SKU is imported under.
12-digit UPC barcode printed on a SKU's packaging.
List price of a SKU to consumers, in the SKU's currency.
Date a SKU first went on sale.
A factory's own code for an item, prefixed with our supplier code because codes repeat across factories: NBBW:MT-2231.
The 3PL warehouse's code for one of our items.
Our purchase order number, e.g. PO-2026-0007.
Supplier a purchase order is placed with.
Where a purchase order is: draft, sent, confirmed, in_production, ready, shipped, received.
Date we placed a purchase order.
Date the supplier's goods leave port: the latest promise until they sail, then the actual date.
Supplier's proforma invoice number confirming a purchase order.
A purchase order line, as PO number and line number: PO-2026-0007/3.
SKU ordered on a purchase order line.
Units ordered on a purchase order line.
Price per unit on a purchase order line, in the order's currency.
Inspection agency's report number for a pre-shipment inspection.
Purchase order whose goods an inspection checked.
Date a pre-shipment inspection took place.
Outcome of a pre-shipment inspection: PASS or FAIL.
Inspection agency that carried out an inspection.
Units the inspector pulled and checked, per the AQL table.
Forwarder's booking (SO) number for an ocean shipment.
House bill of lading number the forwarder issued for a shipment, e.g. PBLHB2600032.
ISO 6346 number of the container a shipment travels in; none for LCL.
How a shipment travels: 40HQ, 20GP or LCL.
Where a shipment is: booked, departed, arrived, delivered.
UN/LOCODE of a shipment's port of loading.
UN/LOCODE of a shipment's port of discharge.
Vessel name and voyage a shipment sails on.
When a shipment leaves its port of loading: estimate, then actual.
When a shipment is expected at its port of discharge, latest estimate.
Ocean freight charged for a shipment, in the shipment's currency.
When a shipment was delivered to our warehouse.
A shipment line, as the shipment's house bill of lading number and the PO line it carries: PBLHB2600032/PO-2026-0023/1.
Purchase order line whose goods a shipment line carries.
Units of a purchase order line loaded in a shipment.
Cartons of a purchase order line loaded in a shipment.
US customs entry number for an import, e.g. HB7-2604013-3.
Shipment a customs entry clears.
Date the broker filed a customs entry.
Value declared to customs on an entry, in the entry's currency.
Duties assessed on an entry, all tariff programmes together.
Merchandise processing and harbor maintenance fees on an entry.
Our code for a place stock can be, e.g. 3PL-NJ.
Readable name of a stock location.
What a location is: factory, in_transit, 3pl or fba.
A SKU at a location, as SKU code @ location code.
SKU a stock position counts.
Location a stock position is at.
Units at a stock position when last counted.
When a stock position was last counted.
Shopify's ID for a product variant.
Amazon's catalogue ID for a product (ASIN).
Amazon fulfilment network SKU on the label of our FBA stock.
SKU we list a product under in Amazon Seller Central.
